parsed.name: PCA9554 I2C GPIO扩展器
parsed.description: PCA9554是一种通过I2C总线连接的通用输入/输出扩展芯片，可为实验控制系统增加额外数字I/O通道。它常用于仪器联动、开关量读写、状态采集和简单外围器件控制。
parsed.description_en: The PCA9554 is an I2C-connected general-purpose input/output expander that adds extra digital I/O lines to laboratory control systems. It is commonly used for instrument interlocks, digital signal read/write, status monitoring, and simple peripheral control.

actions.description: 初始化GPIO扩展器并使其进入可用状态。
actions.description_en: Initialize the GPIO expander and put it into an operational state.
